LALIT SABNANI, PMP
408.623.1710 |sabnani@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/lalitsabnani
i | 
SUMMARY
Hands-on, business savvy, skilled technical leader, meticulous in execution with strong skills in planning, troubleshooting and problem solving. Passionate about Product Development, strategies and implementing best practices penetrating markets with geographically dispersed teams. 
Specialties
Technical Skill
Product, Project & Technical Program Management (TPM)
Materials Program Management & Clear-to-Build (CTB)
Supply Chain Optimization & Demand Planning
Strategic Supplier Negotiations & Contract Management
Quality Assurance, PFMEA & 8D Problem-Solving Methodology
Customer Satisfaction & Digital Transformation (AR/VR Systems)
Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Stakeholder Alignment
Risk Management, Risk Mitigation & Market Red Teaming
Certifications: PMI-PMP (expired) / APICS-CPIM (expired)
Product Roadmap, PLM & Competitive Market Assessment
Agile (Scrum / Kanban) & Waterfall Methodologies
ERP / SAP (SAP BI, BOM Management, Inventory Control)
Data Analytics & Tools: SQL, Python, Tableau, Predictive Analytics
Financial Modeling, Costing (MCOS) & Purchase Price Variance
Business Process Development & Operational Continuous Improvement
Tools & Software: MS Office Suite, Open Source Tools, Unity / CAD 3D
TOP ACHIEVEMENTS
Managed product development of complex high productivity ALD semiconductor equipment tool.
Led Quality Function Deployment, New Product Introduction at Contract Manufacturing sites, doubling yield and increasing throughput 9-fold in six months.
Mitigated risks in ramping solar Concentrated Photo Voltaic Mfg. plants expansion phase.
Led reliability improvement of lid in silicon etcher, increasing Mean-Time-Between-Failures from 100 to 6000 hours, retaining $128M in revenue, restoring confidence of 3 key customers
Developed pulsing generators for etching silicon, improving uniformity and reducing micro-trenching, increasing gross margin by $270K/tool 
Reduced installation and warranty costs by $4M/yr and improving customer satisfaction 8%
Improved ceramic manufacturing process, increasing Mean-Wafers-Between-Clean by 16%
Achieved world class installation at Customer site; created team with Field Service organization and customer teams for brand new product – Got Presidents quality Award
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Applied Materials, Santa Clara, CA (Feb 2013- Dec 2025)
Program Manager (Feb 2013- Feb 2014) 1 year 
Responsible for Product Development –product maturity through the Alpha life cycle, of a high productivity Atomic Layer Deposition tool.
Supported, coordinated design reviews and build of the Rev 0 design.
Completed - learning’s and developed and planned, procurement and built Rev 1 system (with over a 1000 parts) in less than 6 months
Operations Manager, Applied Materials, Santa Clara (Feb 2014- Dec 2025) 11 years 
Product Owner for DFT (Display & Flexible Technologies),  MCOS Visibility Project (Feb 2014 – Feb 2016) 2 years
Responsible for SAPBI MCOS Visibility Development –drive accountability of Material Cost of Sales MCOS to procurement, suppliers, Value chain leaders. Marketing for content and configuration, changes update product cost for GPM gross margin projection calculation providing consistent Cost visibility to the product engineering, supply chain and quality team.
SAPBI consolidated data from multiple ERPs to give Procurement, Engineering, and Sourcing teams accurate part-cost, quote, invoice, and traceability information. The process was designed to reward the best supplier with more orders while providing visibility into quarterly costs and purchase price variance without making assumptions about gross margin. The Best-Known Method was documented, shared, and trained across global teams, then validated by three different people using three different BOMs at three different times before Quality and Finance approval. Once approved, the procedure was posted in IQMS to ensure all future orders followed the same costing method consistently. Overall, the process provided a simple, repeatable, and auditable way to establish and manage part and module costs.
Direct and Module Procurement: Costs and purchases were traceable through the applicable PO, vendor order, and receipt dates.
Contract Pricing: Suppliers awarded a contract were required to be paid the agreed contract price for the part or module.
Floor Stock: For selected commodities, local suppliers delivered stock directly to the shop floor using agreed min/max levels and pricing, with quarterly billing based on actual consumption and the ability to audit when needed.
Program Manager for Testing Go to Market Strategies vs competitors (Mar 2017 – Mar 2018) 1 years
Established Red Team to test out strategies with part of the team play acting as the competition with all of our information. Reviewed patent portfolio, product roadmap, development team/expenses, RD&E partnerships, Go to Market strategies Tested for product portfolios of CVD, PVD and YTG Product Groups
Product Owner for VR/AR Training System (Mar 2017 – Mar 2020) 3 years
A VR training system was developed for field engineers by converting CAD designs into Unity-compatible immersive content, integrating BOMs and OMSs to create 3D build and disassembly sequences. Engineers could interact with modules in VR to understand functions, verify assembly steps, and capture defects or failure metrics, with validation from manufacturing engineering. The system linked to the Integrated OMS portal, enabling visual traceability from BOMs to assembly steps and building a statistical database of assembly performance over time.
Training was optimized to effectively train the Customer Support Engineers for 85% of all product shipped.
Product Owner for Field Engineer Training System (Mar 2021 – Mar 2024) 3 years 
A CE training system was developed for field engineers responsible for installation and PM of the latest Max OLED system by obtaining the assigned CEs for a particular installation. Getting the names of the CEs, giving them the basic training in class or near the system as it was built in Mfg. Working with installation team and site managers identify who will be installing which module. Working on a detailed install plan – from receipt of the module on site to getting it elevated into the floor, working with site logistics team using air casters moving the modules in place. Per the System and Site Preparation Plan. Then connecting the modules per the fit-up plan. Tier 1. Do the startup test – like it was captured in the final test automatically. So, the same set of inputs that were used in module test are repeated on customer site. The same results as were seen in final test can be replicated and captured for comparison.
If there was a demo done for this customers recipe then that too should be replicated from the demo lab data and once the demo is replicated, Tier 2 is complete. The customer should logically sign off on the tool. 
Product Owner  for Serial Number Tracking System (Mar 2024 – Dec 2025) 2 years 
A best known method for tracking Serial numbers of critical modules and OEM parts from cradle to grave was enabled while products were in development, SAP was being upgraded, Warehouse management software was being updated and personnel changed in a multi-country build-test-ship-install-support
Amonix, Seal Beach, CA (2010-June 2012)
Program Manager / Quality Engineer
Responsible for Startup Planning and Risk Mitigation, for Expansion of Mega Module Manufacturing. Deployed Quality Function at Contract Manufacturer, in Milpitas and Malaysia.
Ramped CPV mega module manufacturing from bare warehouse to production in 9 weeks.
Defined critical parameters for Solar Package Manufacturing, successively raised through put 9-fold and improved yield from 35% to 87% in six months
Authored Manufacturing control Plan and PFMEA, Process audits and maintained consistent yields
Led 8D methodology implementation, Learned and implemented Lean Six Sigma green belt methods Resolved wire-bonder and excess RTV defects
Strategic Confluence, San Jose, CA (2009-2010)
Principal / Partner
Selected and implemented ERP system for Violin Memory’s geographically distributed Memory plants
Guided entrepreneurs’ business plans with virtual organizations. –  for Solar, golf and Bioinformatics.
Applied Materials Corp, Santa Clara, CA (1995-2009)
Technical Program Manager, Senior (2006-2009)
Managed product development process to meet market requirements. Captured voice of customer, defined market needs, product requirements, drove product approach, selected solution, defined program charter, product positioning and value pricing. Developed business plans, financial projections, transitioning to manufacturing, customer and field support interactions. 
Executed New Product Introduction, critical etch enhancement – generated $200M
Addressed micro-loading for Silicon Etcher generated $127M in revenue
Created a super gas-panel, with more gases for R&D and demo, saved $3.5M
Operations / FRACAS Manager (2003-2006) {Failure Reporting and Corrective Action System}
Manage controllable expenses, capital expenses and legal expenses. Ensure operational criteria met by product development process, revenue contribution, ROI and accountability to projections. Enabled GM to achieve strategic and tactical goals. Ensured safety of people, place and product.
Managed $2M BLE expenses, within 5% for 7 programs for an organization of 95 people, generating more than $300M annually. Created RDE details to support 3 year and Annual Operating Plan.
Reduced excess content additions, improved gross margin by $18M/qtr.
Consolidated tools, met 4 development schedules, saved $200K/qtr.
Drove Non-Compliance reduction, from 5/tool to 3.1/tool. Ensured reliability at product release MTBF > 500 Hrs. Saving up to $1M per quarter 
Product Marketing Manager (2000-2003)
Managed product life cycle for 300mm eMax2000 Etcher, shipped 101 chambers Q400 to Q202 despite downturn
Developed and released 300mm e-Max, chosen as 2002 BPOTY{Best Product of the Year by Semiconductor International} Introduced Value Added, endpoint detection, allowing for differentiated options
Engineering Manager (1998-2000)
Supported resolution of product issues and developed enhancements. 
Negotiated with suppliers, developed should cost models, saving $30k/ tool
Resolved ceramic dome erosion issue, increasing Mean Time Between Clean by 16% 
Member of Technical Staff (1995-1998)
Supported resolution of product issues and developed enhancements.
Developed and released first simplified electro static chuck for Metal Etch
Developed and released Golden Tool enhancement, reducing tool to tool variability
Micropolis Corp, Chatsworth, CA (1994 – 1995)
Supply Chain Manager, Gandiva
Managed new product sourcing needs used for Raid subsystem and Video On Demand systems.
Amperif / Storage Tek Chatsworth CA/ Boulder CO (1984 – 1994)
Mfg Engineering Manager
Held many positions in startup company, grew from 26 to 150 people, managed materials, production floor, wrote MRP software, transitioned RAID and Tape Drive controllers, managed software quality
EDUCATION
MS in Industrial Engineering & Management, Arizona State University, Tempe, AZ 
BS in Mechanical Engineering, M.S. University, Baroda, India

Dear Hiring Team at Apex Hardware Systems,

When leading complex operational transformations in high-growth organizations, real impact requires more than keeping systems running—it demands driving digital transformation, exercising clear product ownership, leveraging cutting-edge AI tools, and rallying cross-functional teams around a high-value vision.

As a strategic leader passionate about building and leading successful projects with deep expertise in digital transformation, product ownership/management, AI tool integration, and Program Management, Supply Chain Optimization, Materials Management, I was immediately drawn to the Senior Technical Program Manager position at Apex Hardware Systems. Throughout my career, I have specialized in turning intricate technical frameworks into streamlined digital solutions that deliver measurable ROI and operational agility.

Key Highlights & Strategic Capabilities I Bring:
- **Digital Transformation & Product Ownership**: Managed product life cycles from strategic roadmap definition to cross-functional deployment, cutting operational lead times by over 20% while building resilient, data-driven capabilities.
- **Project Leadership & Execution**: Passionate about building and leading high-performing cross-functional teams across engineering, materials management, and operations to deliver successful projects on time and on budget.
- **AI Tools & Workflow Innovation**: Hands-on experience deploying AI tools and automated analytical workflows to optimize decision-making, boost productivity, and drive continuous improvement.
- **Domain Strengths**: Hands-on proficiency in Technical Program Management, Program Management, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Cross-Functional Team Leadership.

I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my digital transformation expertise, AI tool experience, and passion for leading successful projects will accelerate strategic goals for Apex Hardware Systems.

Warm regards,

LALIT SABNANI, PMP
408.623.1710 |sabnani@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/lalitsabnani
